title: kb/_self/coordination.md's list of what kbmon reads names every coord read the coord, sprint and sessions panels make
goal: the section 'What kbmon reads' of kb/_self/coordination.md names the coord.py get of the first open asks' questions, the sprint panel's list --prefix run/ read and the sessions panel's wait --since 0 read

run:
import re, sys
t = open('kb/_self/coordination.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
m = re.search(r'(?ms)^#+ What kbmon reads.*?(?=^#+ |\Z)', t)
sec = m.group(0) if m else ''
need = {'get': re.search(r'\bget\b', sec), 'run/ prefix': 'run/' in sec, 'wait --since': re.search(r'wait\b.*--since|--since.*wait\b', sec)}
print('section found', bool(m), {k: bool(v) for k, v in need.items()})
sys.exit(0 if m and all(need.values()) else 1)

notes: Review gap (S2) of SP-d6gbc3tq: coordination.md:154 omits coord.py get of the first 3 open asks' questions, the sprint panel's own list --prefix run/ read and the sessions panel's wait --since 0 read.
